static_traits.name: Zhou Li
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, with no immediate family in the state
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends who can provide emotional support, but finds it hard to discuss guilt and self-blame with them
static_traits.medical_history: No notable physical illness; no prior history of psychotherapy; no previous similar psychological problem experiences
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to concretely describe experiences and thoughts; attitude is rather negative, mood is low; tends toward self-blame and negative inferences (catastrophizing, overgeneralization, personalization); cooperation is acceptable, willing to try different perspectives

basic_info.main_problem: After the farm I worked at was foreclosed and shut down, I lost my job and persistently experience high stress and guilt, attributing the farm's closure to my own insufficient effort and skills, and I keep blaming myself.
basic_info.core_demands: The farm's closure and self-blame have affected mental health and motivation; hopes to gain support through counseling.
growth_experiences: Last year, the client experienced a severe drought and sluggish market prices; crops were damaged and operations suffered setbacks; a month ago the farm was foreclosed and closed, and the client consequently lost their job. There had been no similar psychological distress or treatment history before; after unemployment, disturbed sleep, reduced interest, and distance from relatives and friends appeared.

core_beliefs: All outcomes depend on my effort; as long as I work hard enough, bad things can be avoided
If my ability is insufficient or I do not work hard enough, a bad outcome is my fault
I am not good enough / not capable enough

special_situations.event: The farm was foreclosed and shut down a month ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I did not work harder or lacked better skills, I must be responsible for the farm's closure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly examining oneself and self-blaming, reducing contact with family and friends to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault; if I tried harder, the farm would not have closed down

special_situations.event: Watching reality shows related to farm life
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should do more and work hard enough to avoid failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immerses in the past by repeatedly watching related content, searching for evidence that they 'should have done better'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I could have done more; I should have worked harder

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One failure means I have never been good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing interaction with the outside world and avoiding social contact to lessen feelings of shame
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Every rejection proves I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Last season encountered a severe drought and sluggish market prices
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Truly capable people can always overcome external factors through effort
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly imagining that one should have found a better way to cope at the time
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I had been more capable then, I could have saved the farm

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable through effort, and to maintain a sense of control over work and life
core_conflict.fear: Fears not being good enough and bears full responsibility for failure, worrying about being judged and losing financial security
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of 'I can still control this' by directing blame toward oneself
Keeping distance from others to reduce the risk of shame and being evaluated

object_relations.self_representation: A guilty failure, an incapable self
object_relations.object_representation: Others are people it is hard to open up to; they may not understand or may judge the self

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others point out that external factors (such as the market and weather) also affected the farm's closure
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client regards acknowledging external factors as shirking responsibility, and therefore chooses to attribute all responsibility to themselves to maintain morality and a sense of control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a self-blaming tone, emphasizes 'I should have done more', ignores external evidence, reduces eye contact with the counselor, and slows the speech rate

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encountering rejection in job hunting or being asked about job-search progress
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets one rejection as a total negation of own ability, believing the future will always be failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Explains failure with seemingly rational but self-blaming statements (such as 'I am not good enough'), ignores other possible factors, with a dejected tone

manifestations: After losing the job, keeping distance from friends and family
Living alone with no immediate family in the state
Unemployment disrupts daily structure and role identity
Losing interest in previously enjoyed activities

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Frequently uses statements like 'I should have done more'
Holds firmly to the belief that 'as long as I work hard enough, everything can be solved'

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: In situations of unemployment and seeking help, reduces contact with friends and family
Converts the impulse to seek help into self-blame and repeated self-examination

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Difficulty giving oneself any affirmation
Viewing one rejection as a total negation of oneself

positive_force: Still actively applying for jobs and seeking financial assistance, showing a degree of persistence and initiative
Has a preliminary willingness to acknowledge external factors (able to mention weather and market issues)
Having a small number of friends who can provide emotional support
Having values of diligence and responsibility
negative_force: Cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and personalization lead to increased self-blame
Viewing one rejection as overall lack of ability, reducing confidence and motivation
Distance from family and friends and reduced socializing weaken the support system
Sleep disturbance and loss of interest; daily functioning is impaired

antecedent: The farm was foreclosed and shut down
Watching reality shows related to farms
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic and personalized cognition internalizes responsibility for external factors (weather, market) into the self
target_behavior.function: Maintaining a sense of control over outcomes and trying to avoid being blamed externally
target_behavior.consequence: Stress increases, motivation decreases, and daily routines are hard to maintain

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding socializing, keeping distance from friends and family
antecedent: When asked about unemployment or job-search progress
target_behavior.core_reason: Avoidance driven by worry about being judged and feelings of shame
target_behavior.function: Escaping possible negative evaluation and emotional discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Social support decreases, loneliness increases, and emotional problems worsen

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep disturbance and loss of interest in activities
antecedent: Financial and life pressure after unemployment
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent stress and negative thinking lead to low mood and disturbed physiological rhythms
target_behavior.consequence: Declined daily functioning, reduced job-search efficiency
